== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|Fire [[aura]] is a form of energy that can be observed through Spiritual sight{{!}}spiritual sight and absorbed into an individual's [[madra]] to increase their power. It is often characterized by a bright red light and intense heat, though it can also manifest as black-and-red or orange. While fire [[aura]] is a distinct power, it frequently exists in conjunction with [[destruction aura]]; for example, the consumption of fuel by fire releases [[destruction aura]], and certain powerful techniques combine both elements to incinerate materials rapidly. In some instances, fire [[aura]] is seen as a component of broader natural forces or specialized powers like [[Blackflame]]. Beyond standard fire, there are variations such as [[soulfire]], which appears as a colorless or silver flame, and [[blue fire]]. Practitioners can use training to draw this [[aura]] into their own [[madra]], potentially altering its nature or using it to fuel advanced techniques and combat maneuvers.}}
